description: Upload every image (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg) in a local folder as Sanity assets. Does not patch any documents. Files that fail are reported in `failed` while the rest still upload. Returns asset IDs, URLs and ready-to-use image references.

dataset.description: Sanity dataset (falls back to SANITY_DATASET env, then 'production')

directory.description: Path to the folder with images

projectId.description: Sanity project ID (falls back to SANITY_PROJECT_ID env)

name: batch_upload
